name: Stripe
description: Customers, payments, invoices and products in your Stripe account.
long_description:
Stripe's own hosted server. It looks up customers, payments, subscriptions and invoices, and can create the objects your account allows.

Two ways in: a **restricted API key** you create in the dashboard — which is the recommendation, because you decide there exactly what the chat may touch — or a browser sign-in. Anything that moves money is confirmed every time, in every mode.

auth.instructions: Create a **restricted** key with only the permissions this chat needs — read-only is a real option, and the better one — and paste it here. A live secret key would give the chat your whole account.

risk.notes: Reaches the Stripe account the key belongs to. Refunds, payouts and anything else that moves money are confirmed every time, in every mode.

auth_alternate.instructions: Sign in to Stripe in your browser instead; the server registers Gantry on the spot.
